metadata.protocol: Fixed before outcomes. Development/work use the earlier 48-tree portfolio corpus; holdout uses 64 new unique non-caterpillar shapes excluding all five earlier benchmark corpora: six per family at orders 35/75 and four at128 (Prüfer, recursive, spider, lobster). Work ablations allow 20,000 visits and30seconds, requiring no time cutoff; baseline and filter must return identical labels/nodes/roots/termination. Complete routes get the same attempt allowance and identical exact fallback; each candidate portfolio shares min(0.1s,10% of attempt) and40,000 nodes,20,000 perstage. Method order rotates by case/repetition. Imports warmed; no concurrent project CPU-heavy jobs. Every witness and fallback model hash is independently checked. No tuning after holdout. Adoption requires no lost cases in any paired repetition and lower median complete-route time; otherwise keep v3. Pipeline/ledger costs are measured separately.

independent_differential_tests.coverage: Eight deterministic mixed-history seeds at four attempt limits, pending/suspected/tied ordering, earlier witnesses followed by unknowns, restricted-only positives, exhausted histories, no max_retries truncation, call-count guards.

pipeline.protocol: Read-only call-count comparison on the exact same saved solved-history ledger. No elapsed-time benchmark or throughput claim. Original implementation retained as storage_before.py; optimized implementation retained as storage_after.py. JSON decoding counts cover case and unrestricted-attempt records in retry_cases. Selection results must agree exactly.
pipeline.scope: retry queue preparation only; all historical audit checks are unchanged
